reviewKind: Lead source self-review, not independent or functional acceptance

decisions.ordinaryIntent: One explicit primary generation click authorizes at most one new text understanding request and the displayed image quote. No normal text or image confirmation modal.
decisions.alternateNew: Change-person / change-group uses the same action=new pipeline with forceNew; no needsAnalysis gate requiring a separate analysis click.
decisions.nonNew: Styling and original-person quote retain original identity/reference semantics and explicit image confirmation; tweak remains draft-only. Failed text request without a saved reply retains a separate explicit retry confirmation.
decisions.reuse: Existing single run lock, APIs, parse contracts, settings GET, controlled DNA sampler and submit quote validation reused. No new dependency or backend behavior.

sequence: prepare captures liveDraft once under the single run lock, before any await; input signature includes owner, full rules/metadata/locks, model, quality, resolution, plan ID, candidate index and ready state.
checkGeneration rejects unknown price, unavailable parameters, unready page and unknown image submission before text understanding.
Existing read-only GET /api/image-studio/settings checks current modelReady and price before text understanding. Changed price updates visible quote and stops without text or image purchase.

readParse checks parse-status and returns the actual parse result directly. Succeeded cache returns immediately. Saved reply can receive at most one free parse-recheck. Only not-started or a separately confirmed failed retry token can call analyze with approveTextModel=true once.

Pending/unknown without a saved reply, failed without explicit retry, needs-clarification and unrecognized/conflicting conditions stop this image operation, preserve text/history and display server parse status. No paid retry loop.
API returned descriptionId/parserVersion passes directly into prepare. No setParseStatus then stale activeParse read, render wait, effect-triggered generation or React 19 API.

assertDraft validates monotonic input revision and owner revision after every parse/settings/prepare await and before submit. Changing fields and later changing back still invalidates old work; old errors/parse cannot overwrite a new draft.

submit checks exact selected image parameters/layout and people, then compares prepared output count and unit credits against click-time visible quote. Any direct-generation quote mismatch updates quote and stops; no automatic quantity/model increase.

Exact plan/rules/parameters and pending plan ID persist before image POST. Existing idempotent plan ID, query-only unknown-submission recovery and server revision/unit/draft/layout checks remain. New plan retains previous image and tracks older queued/running plans.

After POST, ownerRevision/planRef guard credits and UI responses. Submitted notice does not claim image completion. Separate original-quote and failed-item retry now capture draft before their API await.
Typing/600ms inspection/restoration/polling remain read-only. A late background parse-status result cannot overwrite an in-progress explicit pipeline. Restore never calls analyze or submit.

cost.userNotice: Actual output quantity, unit credits and total image credits are shown beside the main button. First understanding of new text may incur upstream text-model cost; amount is unknown, not advertised as free or as a known cash total.
cost.exceptions: Cached interpretation and saved-reply recheck do not create another text-model request. Explicit failed-text retry explains possible additional cost and does not itself submit images.
